name: The Gate of the South and the Muster Hall
reading: Giovanni's town is a garrison and its gym is the gate: the building everyone walks past, and for the eighth badge the one you have to go through to leave. The gate is shut -- a sheer granite face with the blind arch of the gate that does not open -- so the way past is the way a garrison takes a shut gate: in at the yard's side gate, down the sap (the one well with a headframe), along the drift to the one heading that is shored and lit, up into the sally under four ranked bulkheads, and through the blast door into the muster hall behind the gate. The hall is the post that holds when the gate does not: deepslate tile and polished granite, the earth the bunker was dug into showing at the wall foot, ribs and pit-props, the garrison's orange on the floor where it falls in, and at the far end the command dais under the situation map. A ground type, in his own ground. Out past him by the postern in the east wall (an iron door, its button inside) onto the yard, or back the way you came.

replaces.why: what stood before this hall and is taken down by it, measured from the records that built it, never guessed. The arena is data/gym_arenas/gym8.json as it was built and applied to staging on 2026-10-09 (schema gym_arena/1, git history): 22 courses under the lot, reached by a 61-tread newel stair from the gate walk. The building is data/gym_buildings/gym8.json, kept, now superseded_by this file. Below the lot the takedown function (gym8_takedown) fills the arena's bounds and the descent's part under the pad with stone; above it this hall's first parts clear the lot and overwrite the building's nine courses under the pad.

exit.why: the postern past the leader: an iron door in the hall's east wall at the dais's flank, opened by the stone button on the wall inside it; out through a recess in the gate's face onto the yard and east to the gate. Nothing outside opens it, so it cannot be used to reach Giovanni past the sap and its juniors. Or back the way you came: the trench, the heading and the stairs are walked both ways.
